description: Target mode, `%` is never touched (MCPWARP.md §4.3): a `%` not followed by two hex digits (`%zz`, a trailing `50%`) is kept as is, not rewritten to `%25`, and the valid escape `%20` is not decoded. The target URL's own query (`k=1`) comes first, joined to the request's query with `&`, both verbatim (no URLSearchParams-style rebuild). MCPWARP.md §4.6
in:
POST /mcp?a=%zz&b=x%20y&c=50% HTTP/1.1
Host: notes-tester.mcpwarp.test
accept: application/json, text/event-stream
content-type: application/json
user-agent: Go-http-client/1.1
Content-Length: 40

{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
out:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/json
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

28
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
0
notes: In target mode `handler` describes the local server, and upstream.url is the request line it receives (as an absolute URL). ws-mixer-go before v0.9.0 rewrote a lone `%` to `%25`.
